name: Győrvár (Hungary)
description: Yellow field with a red triangle in the upper fly and a green triangle in the lower fly, both with their points reaching the hoist, charged in the hoist with the municipal arms of Győrvár: a white, yellow and green shield with a horse's head, crossed sabres and a castle wall.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
